text: ポケモンは　しゅるいに　よって　せいちょうする　テンポが　ちがう　らしいわ

structure.jp: しゅるいに　よって
せいちょうする　テンポが
structure.en: the pace at which they grow

patterns.name: 〜によって
patterns.span: しゅるいに　よって
patterns.explanation: によって after a thing means 'depending on' it. しゅるいに　よって = 'depending on the species'.

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい at the end says you heard this or judge it from what you know, not that you are sure. ちがう　らしい = 'apparently it differs'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: せいちょうする　テンポ
patterns.explanation: A verb placed before a thing tells you which thing it is. せいちょうする　テンポ = 'the pace at which they grow'.
